title: Operator Mode
subtitle: From Company to Portfolio. Every Decision Compounds.
description: A two-season AI value-creation apprenticeship for operators who need to connect product judgment, production AI, operating design, scaling, and private-equity returns. Season One puts you inside Harborline Systems from underwrite to exit. Season Two, Portfolio Control, promotes you into a three-company operating-partner simulation where capital, agents, talent, platform boundaries, regulation, M&A, and fund liquidity collide. Every episode gives you incomplete evidence, forces a decision, and carries the consequences forward.
author: Asha Raman & Cole Mercer
